owner_messages: No need to have a review layer. This is not production practice. How many chunks do we retreive? We should not retreive 20 chunks. Only Top 5 should be retreived. If the top 5 disagree for both retreival models for the top 3, then run reranker to order the top 5. No other reviewed piece should be given.
My review should not block citing the manual.
Tell me is raw parser JSON passing required or beneficial? remove if not.

For source disagreement, share both. We need to make sure relevant warnings are passed. Docling or how chunks are made should be done in a manner that only relevant warnings are mapped the first time embeddings are made.
I am okay to test Haiku vs Sonnet.
remove the deployed. that is bad. Candidate should be kept and the above issues to be sorted.
haiku, haiku high, sonnet. but do it here instead of claude API

Rebuild MotoMedic's candidate answer path with no review layer, measure it against the v2 run on the same 30 questions, then make it the only answer path in the repo. [...] If the Haiku arm has no unfaithful cited statement and at least 27/30 correct, the candidate replaces draft-then-verify and the review gate in cloud/grounded_generation and the worker wiring. [...] No GCP, billing, Haiku-ledger or deployment changes.

decisions.integration_bar: HAIKU_AT_HIGH_EFFORT_MET_IT (30/30 released and correct, 0 unfaithful cited statements); HAIKU_AT_DEFAULT_EFFORT_DID_NOT (24/30, 6 gate failures, 0 unfaithful)
